title: Nourishing Brazilian Bean Sprouts Wrap
description: A funky and aerated Brazilian dish featuring bean sprouts, cooked in a clay pot and wrapped in a corn husk, perfect for a midnight craving. This low-carb-friendly wrap is a unique and delicious twist on traditional Brazilian cuisine.
instructions: Preheat the clay pot over medium heat.
Add the coconut oil and saute the chopped onion until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the bean sprouts and cook until they start to soften.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Warm the corn husks by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20 seconds.
Assemble the wraps by spooning the bean sprout mixture onto a corn husk and folding the sides.
Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 24 hours.
